coverage: All 13 administrative regions are shown as geographic context. Language presence is documented for named localities; shading does not indicate a majority or a complete distribution. No current regional census speaker counts are available in this layer. Mount Athos is a separate autonomous territory and is not one of these 13 regions.
report_note: Mixed-date linguistic documentation, consulted 2026-11-05. Location notes are not evidence of the number of speakers in 2026.

GR-RISEUP-DISTRIBUTION.population_scope: Named locations only; not a population sample or census
GR-RISEUP-DISTRIBUTION.notes: RISE UP / LanguageMap country profile, compiled from multiple sources. Historical distribution and present-day vitality are distinct. No national estimates are converted into regional counts. Greek language censuses ceased after 1951. Region allocation is an editorial geographic crosswalk, not a speaker boundary.
